format: 2025 field configuration proposal. Device IDs and channel positions are uncommissioned. Distances are one-way design maxima in metres. AWG denotes copper supply and return.

sensorChannels.camera: USB 3 to Pi 4B; wired Ethernet to VH-109 AUX1 PoE off
sensorChannels.pads: three moving piezoresistive pads to observer ADS1015 channels A0/A1/A2; wired I2C host only
sensorChannels.encoders: six dedicated NEO Hall-sensor plugs to matching SPARK MAX
sensorChannels.AI0: TE SP1-25 slide string potentiometer; 5 V excitation, ground reference and calibrated ratio
sensorChannels.liftReference: NEO lift encoder after qualified lower/upper homing, independent position tolerance unresolved
sensorChannels.observerADC0x48: Existing 3 pad inputs dedicated to first ADS1015. Do not insert other channels into the 2 ms triplet budget.
sensorChannels.observerADC0x49: Additional ADS1015 at 3.3 V records four AS5600 analog channels (grip front idlers L/R, slide sync pinions 1/2); 3.3 V sensor supply or conditioned range required. No raw high voltage at inputs.
sensorChannels.timing: Publish each observation with monotonic acquisition and freshness. SHARE NO POWER AUTHORITY with coprocessor. Stop when an angle wraps ambiguously, either rail fails, data ages out or axes disagree.
